verdicts.evidence: TimDaub replied to tongyaosafe's thread and the Codex thread: 'Fixed in f320203d0: one row per Safe and chain'. At HEAD, PoliciesTable/index.tsx has no toRows and uses getRowKey={(policy) => policy.id}.

Commit 01976729e ('let the search find policies by network') adds a `network` field (chain name + chainId) to the Fuse keys in hooks/usePolicySearch.ts. The author confirmed the fix in the Codex thread.

In reply to tongyaosafe's role=button thread, TimDaub said f320203d0 keeps the row a table row, ignores clicks on nested controls, and puts focus on a real chevron Button. That Button is in PoliciesTable/index.tsx at HEAD.

The author called pagination optional, but f320203d0 dropped the per-Safe merge. Rows are now keyed by policy.id, so mockLongPolicyList(30) gives 30 distinct rows instead of 3 rows with duplicate keys.
The author said 'Done in f320203d0, with your format'. At HEAD, getOpenPolicyLabel returns `Open ${getPolicyLabel(policy)} for ${shortenAddress(...)}` on the chevron button.
The author said the helper was moved to utils/policyTokens.ts in f320203d0. At HEAD, usePolicySearch.ts imports getPolicyTokens from '../utils/policyTokens'.

Nobody replied to the NetworkLogosPill comment, and that component was not adopted. After f320203d0 each row shows a single ChainIndicator for policy.safe.chainId, so a row can no longer list many chains.
Nobody replied to tongyaosafe's 'Please follow the template for PR description' comment. The PR body can't be seen from the repo, so there is no evidence it was changed.
